witness.branch: Qualifying nonmotor vehicle parked within the nighttime window
witness.quote: Except for a motor vehicle, no person shall park any vehicle on any street for a period of time longer than thirty minutes between the hours of one a.m. and six a.m. of any day.
witness.reason: Curbside parking can realize an extended nighttime episode for a qualifying nonmotor vehicle.
required_context: Establish a device that meets the supplied vehicle definition and is neither a motor vehicle nor an excluded device; the actor name alone is insufficient.
Establish responsible person, parking purpose, absence of actual temporary loading or unloading, and civil-time episode boundaries.

Establish the entire street boundaries, public vehicular access, city limits and LVMC applicability.
Establish the responsible person and a device capable of transporting persons or property that is neither self-propelled nor within any supplied vehicle-definition exclusion.

witness.subject_reason: The available nonmotor_vehicle_operator can be the person responsible for parking a qualifying vehicle, subject to explicit classification evidence.
